paper.title_en: Gravitational waves from cosmic superstrings and gauge strings
paper.abstract_en: We perform a phenomenological comparison of the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum expected from cosmic gauge string networks and superstring networks comprised of multiple string types. We show how violations of scaling behavior and the evolution of the number of relativistic degrees of freedom in the early Universe affect the GW spectrum. We derive simple analytical expressions for the GW spectrum from superstrings and gauge strings that are valid for all frequencies relevant to pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and laser interferometers. We analyze the latest data from PTAs and show that superstring networks are consistent with 32 nHz data from NANOGrav, but are excluded by 3.2 nHz data at $3σ$ unless the string coupling $g_s<0.2$ or the strings evolve in only about 10% of the volume of the higher-dimensional space. We also point out that while gauge string networks are excluded by NANOGrav-15 data at $3σ$, they are completely compatible with EPTA and PPTA data. Finally, we study correlations between GW signals at PTAs and laser interferometers.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文对宇宙规范弦网络与超弦网络产生的引力波谱进行现象学比较，并系统分析其与PTA及激光干涉仪最新数据的兼容性，直接关联脉冲星计时阵列主题，理论推导与数据分析结合紧密，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 宇宙超弦与规范弦产生的引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们对宇宙规范弦网络与由多种弦类型组成的超弦网络所预期的引力波（GW）谱进行了现象学比较。我们展示了标度行为的破坏以及早期宇宙相对论自由度数量的演化如何影响引力波谱。我们推导出超弦和规范弦引力波谱的简洁解析表达式，这些表达式对于与脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉仪相关的所有频率均成立。我们分析了PTA的最新数据，并表明超弦网络与NANOGrav的32 nHz数据一致，但除非弦耦合 $g_s<0.2$ 或弦仅在更高维空间约10%的体积中演化，否则会被3.2 nHz数据在 $3\sigma$ 水平上排除。我们还指出，虽然规范弦网络被NANOGrav-15数据在 $3\sigma$ 水平上排除，但它们与EPTA和PPTA数据完全兼容。最后，我们研究了PTA与激光干涉仪之间引力波信号的相关性。
